office: the Junta Central Electoral (JCE), Dirección Nacional de Cedulación

routes.label: at a JCE cedulation centre, by appointment

note: The JCE's requirements page: a first cédula from 16 (with a parent at 16 and 17). Its tariff for offices abroad (2025): a first cédula and a renewal cost nothing, a mobile cedulation USD 50 or 80 and a reprint 15 (not modelled). The JCE's domestic tariff page loads by script and gave no figure this session, so the fee at home is null; the card's term and the time aren't stated.

sources.title: Junta Central Electoral, Servicios y Requisitos de Cedulación
sources.said: Tipo de solicitud: Nuevo Inscrito (menor de Edad, 16 a 17 años) Tener 16 o 17 años.
